incident.root_cause: CreateDatabaseStage wrote DB_PASSWORD unquoted into .env (template line DB_PASSWORD=__DB_PASS__, replaced by sed). The 32-char password charset included '#'. vlucas/phpdotenv 5.x (EntryParser UNQUOTED_STATE) starts a comment at ANY '#', not only after whitespace, so Laravel read a truncated prefix: 'aB3xY9#kLm2!' -> 'aB3xY9'. P(password contains '#') = 35.9%; installation 50 happened not to.
ruled_out: Stage order: GENERATE_ENVIRONMENT -> CREATE_DATABASE -> RUN_MIGRATIONS is identical in installations 50 and 51 (release 280 only moved CONFIGURE_DNS and added VALIDATE_DOMAIN_DNS).

Host mismatch: production MySQL 8.0.45 has skip_name_resolve=OFF and bind_address=127.0.0.1, so a TCP connection to 127.0.0.1 authenticates as 'user'@'localhost' (as the error shows); installation 50 used the same path successfully.
SQL / shell quoting of CREATE USER: escapeshellarg on Linux and a charset without quote or backslash.
incident.production_mysql: 8.0.45-0ubuntu0.24.04.1; validate_password.policy=MEDIUM, special_char_count=1, mixed_case_count=1, number_count=1, length=8, check_user_name=ON
